title: Application configuration schema
description: Schema for the application configuration file (project/app.json).

version.description: Semantic version of the shape used for this file.

projectId.description: Unique identifier for this project. Used for settings storage.

strings.description: Localized strings for the application UI.

errorStrings.description: Localized error strings for the application UI.

errorImages.description: Error image names for various error scenarios.

additionalProperties.description: Name of the image to use for the error.

paths.description: Optional path overrides for project resources.

header.description: Header configuration for the application shell.

fullWidth.description: Whether the header should span the full width of the viewport.

height.description: Height of the header in pixels.

bordered.description: Whether the header should have a bottom border.

items.description: Ordered list of items to display in the header.

navbar.description: Navbar (sidebar) configuration for the application shell.

width.description: Width of the navbar when expanded, in pixels.

collapsible.description: Whether the navbar can be collapsed.

collapsedWidth.description: Width of the navbar when collapsed, in pixels.

bordered.description: Whether the navbar should have a right border.

icons.description: Whether to show only icons when the navbar is collapsed.

footer.description: Whether to show a footer area in the navbar.

items.description: Ordered list of items to display in the navbar.

footerItems.description: Ordered list of items to display in the navbar footer.

userToolbar.description: Ordered list of items to display in the header toolbar.

menu.description: Menu configuration for the application shell.

openSubmenusOnHover.description: Whether submenu menus should open on hover instead of click.

submenuOffset.description: Horizontal offset for submenu positioning, in pixels.

items.description: Default menu item styling and behavior.

submenuItems.description: Default submenu styling for menu items. Inherits from 'items' properties.

toolbars.description: Toolbar properties for forms and listViews.

topControls.description: List of controls used in the application shell.

mainTitle.description: Title configuration for the application shell.

collapseToggle.description: Configuration for the navbar toggle button tooltips.

rotateIcon.description: Whether to rotate the toggle icon when toggling.

tipCollapse.description: Tooltip text when hovering the collapse button.

tipExpand.description: Tooltip text when hovering the expand button.

logo.description: Logo configuration for the application shell.

collapsedHeight.description: Collapsed height of the logo in pixels, or 'auto'.

expandedHeight.description: Expanded height of the logo in pixels, or 'auto'.

collapsedWidth.description: Collapsed width of the logo in pixels, or 'auto'.

expandedWidth.description: Expanded width of the logo in pixels, or 'auto'.

altText.description: Alternative text for the logo image.

link.description: Optional link target for clicking the logo.

themeSwitch.description: Configuration for the theme switcher control.

tipLight.description: Tooltip text for switching to light theme.

tipDark.description: Tooltip text for switching to dark theme.

controls.description: Generic control used by toolbar/menu actions.

additionalProperties.description: Definition for a control used in this project.

fullHeight.description: If true, the form will take the full available height.

width.description: Width of the form. Can be a number (pixels) or a string (CSS value).

themeSwitch.description: If true, shows a theme switch control on the login form.

logo.description: Logo configuration for the login form.

height.description: Height of the logo image in pixels (optional).

width.description: Width of the logo image in pixels (optional).

altText.description: Alternative text for the logo image.

image.description: Filename of the login image to use in light mode.
Filename of the login image to use in dark mode.

toolbar.description: Configuration for the login form toolbar.

upperBorder.description: If true, shows a border line above the toolbar.

fields.description: Field definitions for the login form.

listViews.description: Default settings for list views and data tables.

defaultList.description: Name of the default list to show when navigating to /lists.

table.description: Default data table settings for list views.

striped.description: Whether table rows should be striped.

bordered.description: Whether the table should have borders.

rowBorders.description: Whether table rows should have borders.

colBorders.description: Whether table columns should have borders.

wrapperSize.description: Size of the wrapper elements in the table.

wrapperBooleanWidth.description: Width of the boolean wrapper elements.

booleanIconsStroke.description: Stroke width of the boolean icons.

footerIconsStroke.description: Stroke width of the footer icons.

headerIconsStroke.description: Stroke width of the header icons.

trueIcon.description: Icon used for true boolean values.

falseIcon.description: Icon used for false boolean values.

labelPosition.description: Position of labels in the filter panels: 'top' or 'none'.

verticalPadding.description: Vertical padding for the filter panels.

transitionDuration.description: Duration of the filter panel transition.

filterToolbar.description: Toolbar settings for filter panel. Overrides the toolbar object.

actionToolbar.description: Settings for the action toolbar used for individual records. Overrides the toolbar object.

messageBox.description: Settings for the message boxes used in list views.

icon.description: Attributes for the icon used for the message boxes.

size.description: Size of the message box icon.

stroke.description: Stroke width of the message box icon.

filled.description: Whether the message box icon is filled.

toolbar.description: Settings for the modal toolbar used for record actions. Overrides the toolbar object.

deleteControls.description: Toolbar configuration for the delete message box.

pagination.description: Default pagination settings for list views.

defaultPageSize.description: Default number of rows per page in list views.

pageSizes.description: Available page sizes for list views.

showFirstLast.description: Whether to show first/last page buttons.

showPageSizeSelector.description: Whether to show the page size selection dropdown.

showTotalItems.description: Whether to show the total number of items.

infiniteScroll.description: Default infinite scroll settings for list views.

threshold.description: Scroll threshold in pixels to trigger loading more items.

forms.description: Default settings for forms and form toolbars.

verticalGap.description: Default vertical gap between form rows.

fullHeight.description: Whether forms should take full height.

clearSelectionValue.description: Special value used to clear select components.

selectionCheck.description: Whether to show selection check controls.

checkboxTopPadding.description: Top padding applied to checkbox fields.

outlinedSections.description: Whether form groups should be outlined.

imageRadius.description: Default border radius for image fields.

imageHeight.description: Default component height for image fields.

tabs.description: Default tab layout settings for forms.

iconSize.description: Size of the icons used in the tabs.

toolbar.description: Toolbar settings for forms. Overrides the toolbar object.

theme.description: Theme configuration including palette, typography and list densities.

defaultUIScale.description: Default UI scale factor, in percentage (e.g. 100%, 95%).

iconFamily.description: Default icon family to use in the application.

mainFontFamily.description: Primary font family. May be null to use system default.

headingsFontFamily.description: Font family for headings. May be null to use system default.

iconMapMaterial.description: Mapping of custom icon names to Material Syymbol icon names for this project.

additionalProperties.description: Name of the Material Syymbol icon.

iconMapTabler.description: Mapping of custom icon names to Tabler icon names for this project.

colorEntry.description: A simple color entry with main color and an optional text color.

main.description: Hex or CSS color string for the main color.

text.description: Color used for text/icons on top of the main color.

backgroundEntry.description: Background color entries for default and paper surfaces.

default.description: Background color used for page backgrounds (e.g. body).

paper.description: Background color used for surface/paper elements.

modePalette.description: Palette entries for a single mode (light or dark).

menuItemsStyles.description: Default menu item styling and behavior.

gap.description: Gap between menu item icon and label.

labelSize.description: Font size for menu item labels.

labelWeight.description: Font weight for menu item labels.

subtitleUppercase.description: Whether subtitles should be rendered in uppercase.

descriptionSize.description: Font size for menu item descriptions.

descriptionWeight.description: Font weight for menu item descriptions.

iconFilled.description: Whether menu icons should be filled (true) or outlined (false).

iconSize.description: Size of menu icons in pixels.

arrowStroke.description: Stroke width for submenu arrow icons.

arrowSize.description: Size of submenu arrow icons in pixels.

menuItem.description: A single menu item for sidebar settings menus. Can be recursive via 'items'.

name.description: Logical name or key for the menu item. Used for i18n and settings lookup.

type.description: Kind of item: menu (select), submenu (group), action (click), separator (visual).

icon.description: Material icon name to render alongside the item.

defaultOption.description: Default selected option value for menu/select items.

label.description: i18n key for the menu item label.

action.description: Named action to dispatch when this item is activated (e.g. 'setTheme').

value.description: Value associated with this item (for options and actions).

selectable.description: Whether the control can be selected/toggled.

items.description: Nested menu items for submenu structures (recursive).

fieldSizes.description: Allowed field size values for forms.

buttonVariant.description: Allowed component variant values for buttons.

selectedTip.description: Tooltip text when the button is in selected/toggled state.

toggle.description: Whether the button is a toggle button.

action.description: Named action to dispatch when clicked.

default.description: Whether this is the default button (triggered on Enter key).

items.description: Nested menu items for dropdown buttons.

name.description: Logical name or key for the control.

label.description: Label text for text buttons or menu items.

selectedTip.description: Tooltip text when the control is in selected/toggled state.

toggle.description: Whether the control is a toggle button.

action.description: Named action to dispatch when the control is activated.

default.description: Whether this control is the default action (e.g. primary form button).

link.description: Optional navigation link for the control.

items.description: Optional nested menu items for dropdown controls.

class.description: Optional CSS class name(s) to apply to the control.

width.description: Width of the control; can be a CSS size value or number of pixels.

modeProps.description: Used to define properties for light and dark modes.

expandedLogo.description: Image file to be shown when the navbar is expanded.

collapsedLogo.description: Image file to be shown when the navbar is collapsed.

upperBorder.description: Whether the toolbar should have an upper border.

position.description: Position of the toolbar relative to the form. "right" is not allowed for record forms.

iconButtons.description: Default settings for icon buttons in toolbars.

rotateSelected.description: Whether to rotate the icon when selected.

radius.description: Border radius of the icon button.

filled.description: Whether the icon button should be filled.

selectedVariant.description: Default variant for selected icon buttons.

selectedIcon.description: Icon name to use when a dropdown item is in selected/toggled state.

textButtons.description: Default settings for text buttons in toolbars.

radius.description: Border radius of the text button.

fontSize.description: Font size of the button label.

fontWeight.description: Font weight of the button label.

uppercase.description: Whether the button label should be uppercase.

defaultVariant.description: Default variant for default (primary) text buttons.

texts.description: Default settings for text elements in toolbars.

titles.description: Default settings for title elements in toolbars.
